subject: BUG: update_geom_defaults fails to change default outlier aesthetics of geom_boxplot

messages.author: a27a46fa1c1d735a
messages.subject: BUG: update_geom_defaults fails to change default outlier aesthetics of geom_boxplot
parts:
Hi,

The following lines produce a boxplot with colour='blue', but outliers still
have shape=16 and size=2.

update_geom_defaults("boxplot",
list(colour='blue', outlier.shape=1, outlier.size=5))

ggplot(diamonds, aes(depth, carat)) + geom_boxplot()

So, it seems that the default values of outlier parameters are not updated
by update_geom_defaults. I would consider this a bug.

Sorry if this isn't the right place to report bugs.

messages.subject: Re: BUG: update_geom_defaults fails to change default outlier aesthetics of geom_boxplot
parts:
On 1/11/2013 7:41 AM, Ernest Adrogu� wrote:
> Hi,
>
> The following lines produce a boxplot with colour='blue', but outliers still
> have shape=16 and size=2.
>
> update_geom_defaults("boxplot",
> list(colour='blue', outlier.shape=1, outlier.size=5))
>
> ggplot(diamonds, aes(depth, carat)) + geom_boxplot()
>
> So, it seems that the default values of outlier parameters are not updated
> by update_geom_defaults. I would consider this a bug.

It is not really a bug, but it does look like one (and maybe things
should be changed so that it does work this way). update_geom_defaults
updates the default values that an aesthetic will take when it is not
mapped to a variable. In geom_boxplot, the aesthetics are listed as:
lower, middle, upper, x, ymax, ymin, alpha, colour, fill, linetype,
shape, size, and weight. outlier.colour, outlier.shape, and outlier.size
are not aesthetics but rather arguments to geom_boxplot. That means that
they can not be mapped to a variable, but it also means that their
default values can not be changed by update_geom_defaults. It also means
that the value of those must be the same for an entire layer.
> Sorry if this isn't the right place to report bugs.

The bug reporting system is at https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues

However, it is fine to inquire here on the mailing list if you are not
sure if something is a bug or if something does not behave as you
expect. If it is a bug, then you may be asked to file a formal bug
report, but if it is not then it does not clutter the bug database.
